title: At least seven agents with work I can check
description: At least seven agents with work I can check, grouped by what they delivered. Two audited the dashboard, and two built and reviewed the fence. One reviewed the start-up code and one reviewed the check instructions. One lead agent found a crash cause and retracted its own reviews. More agents ran, but their work is harder to check.
source: Public commits and issue comments for 8 October 2026; distinct agent sessions with a checkable result, a minimum, not a census
note: More agents ran, but I can't tell from the records what each of them did.
